combo_label: Pets & Petcare × Baking & Cakes × The Wild West

entries.clue: Silky blend of chocolate and warm cream, poured on as a glossy coat
Tiny jumping biter that a drop on the neck sees off
Looped rope a rider whirls overhead to catch a running calf
Cowboy's broad-brimmed felt hat, the maker's surname now the word for it
Fine mesh bowl tapped to break up lumps before mixing
Panicked mass charge of hooves that flattens everything ahead
Cheek-stuffing rodent that runs a squeaky wheel all night
Soft sugar paste rolled into a sheet and draped over a wedding cake
Prearranged one-on-one fight; the quick-draw street version is mostly film myth
Neck band carrying a name tag and a jingling bell
